tools.name: getFeedspaceFeatures
tools.description: Get the list of Feedspace features for collecting, importing, managing and displaying reviews and testimonials. Use this when the user asks what Feedspace can do, or whether it supports a particular capability.

tools.name: getFeedspacePricing
tools.description: Get Feedspace plans, prices, billing options and per-plan limits. Use this when the user asks what Feedspace costs, which plan suits them, or what a plan includes.
